description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for 'Program' entities in the OpenMRS platform. It extends a base datatype class, and provides a method to deserialize a 'Program' object from its UUID string, utilizing OpenMRS services.

classes.name: ProgramDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype component for handling 'Program' entities within OpenMRS, annotated as a Spring component, and providing deserialization functionality.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Program object by fetching it from the ProgramWorkflowService. Returns null if the input string is blank.
